[Pedagogy review · Suggestion · extension · pf-0ad2e6db08]
After p14-f, add: (g) Jenny reduces her monthly fixed expense by $1000. The cost per sandwich and selling price stay the same. Write the new cost equation. Answer: C=500+1.5n. (h) How many sandwiches must now be sold to break even? Answer: 250. (i) Explain why the $1000 reduction means she needs to sell 500 fewer sandwiches to break even. Answer: Each sandwich contributes $3.50−$1.50=$2 towards fixed expenses, and $1000÷$2=500.
